notes.title: Play NO EXIT PLATEST NOW! (Full chapter 1 and 2)
notes.content:
PLAYTEST IS OUT RIGHT NOW![previewyoutube="B_dL-rIXhuU;full"][/previewyoutube]

NO EXIT Chapter 1 and 2 are out right now!

…Or rather, they’ve actually been out for around 2 weeks already.

You may be wondering why I didn’t make an announcement here earlier. Well, giving myself some time after publishing allowed me to make extra changes, fix bugs, and polish rough edges! That’s why I think now is finally the right time to make a proper announcement here.


What’s in the Playtest?

In this playtest, you can play through the full CHAPTER 1 and CHAPTER 2. If you’re out of the loop, that’s 2 out of 3 chapters.

Currently, after a big break, I’ll be starting the long journey of developing CHAPTER 3 (c’mon, I’ve been working on this game for 3 years now, I needed a break, lmao).

But worry not! I plan to keep you updated on Chapter 3’s development as it goes on, including later in this post.

First, let’s talk about what’s actually included in the PLAYTEST.




CHAPTER 1
Chapter 1 includes around 20 minutes of gameplay and serves as a prologue to the game’s story!
In this chapter, you’ll encounter 2 chase sequences, a small boss encounter, lots of spooks, and even some exploration. It also introduces the phone’s first ability: FLASH!

This chapter also features the first and for now, only CD Disc in the game (the full release will include more).

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45286153/68a29cf974481d80f695ee966d31fcf797661e30.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45286153/acd89b208ecf2dd3c62bfa0ee9cab194c1a7e2fa.png"]^ ^ ^ Some cool Chapter 1 Screenshots ^ ^ ^




CHAPTER 2
Chapter 2 continues the story, introducing the main villain along with three very important characters who play a key role in the plot.

In this chapter, you'll face 3 challenging boss encounters, with funky reactive music! As well as 3 chases, some spooks, easy yet fun puzzles and fun lore!

This chapter also introduces the phone’s second ability: SONAR.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45286153/3bf7327a079d877b98d4c98e383c91580403465b.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45286153/5250ca5b1c19ad343efc0cd7b558599ef1481b12.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45286153/6b8cf1170adec0b797e846d42aa07df951ddf2e4.png"]^ ^ ^ Some cool Chapter 2 Screenshots ^ ^ ^




What's up with CHAPTER 3?


Well, I can definitely make a few promises. I can’t guarantee I’ll deliver on all of them, but I’ll try, I always do!
(DONT UNBLUR IF YOU HAVEN’T PLAYED THE PLAYTEST YET)

[spoiler]Knowledge's and Chekov's relations ship expanded.[/spoiler]

[spoiler]2 brand-new characters, plus some returning familiar faces from both Chapter 1 and Chapter 2![/spoiler]

[spoiler]4 brand-new complex areas![/spoiler]

[spoiler]The story will be fully finished, with a proper closure — no cliffhangers![/spoiler]

A full original score composed by my extremely talented friend, Kai “Kaiser” Ronan!

[spoiler]Dealmaker’s real name revealed …and let’s just say, he’s extremely pissed at you :3[/spoiler]



Here's some screenshots for you all...

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45286153/1ef2dd56d8bca5342f097e3b83203f77934f6d7a.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45286153/e17b2849bb85410dcc53a12f851ca0ab3494c9cd.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45286153/51478c074d31c9317521336a528f9dd910321e73.png"]ALL OF THESE SCREENSHOTS ARE SUBJECTS

notes.title: NO EXIT Development! (and where to follow it)
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45286153/4d516d63763cf49ed1d7df892c0192c6933216ca.png"]
I'm Bart, developer of this small indie horror game called NO EXIT, and this is my first post here! I had absolutely no idea how to do these announcement things, but I'm glad I figured it out!

If you only follow this game here on Steam, you might have noticed a lack of updates on development.

Rest assured, I’m working on it every day. Keep in mind I’m a solo developer, getting barely any help from outside besides some astonishingly talented voice actors (apart from my own voice) and a few music tracks being composed by my friend. Development might take a while, but there’s still a good reason to follow the game and this page for updates that might happen, such as EARLY-ACCESS/BETA, and more.\



OK, But where to follow for more frequent updates?

Well, you can join the official NO EXIT Discord server! I’m fairly active over there and I don’t mind answering questions. It’s also the first place where I post any news + lots of bloopers and memes so feel free to join if you’d like! 

To join up, click -> HERE  HERE <-
Or here :3
SECOND FUNNY BUTTON



Thank you for reading that annoucement, and have a GREAT day, night, evening, noon, afternoon, night, all that!
